groups.problem: Opening a missing English counterpart file throws RuntimeException and aborts verification.
groups.rationale: All three report the same unconditional file-opening failure. The regex and naming examples explain how the counterpart can be missing rather than reporting separate problems.

groups.problem: The Simplified Chinese account totpStep1 translation was replaced with Traditional Chinese.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same replacement on line 112 and request Simplified Chinese text.

groups.problem: Overlapping common-prefix and common-suffix scans can produce invalid substring bounds and crash verification.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same bounds error in the diagnostic construction and propose limiting the suffix scan by the prefix length.

groups.problem: The same Italian OTP setup instruction was copied into the Lithuanian account and login translations.
groups.rationale: S3 and S4 identify the two instances of the same copied translation mistake; S8 explicitly reports both. Each location needs the same translation correction.
